patterns_discovered.description: Uses --report flag to switch between detailed findings (original report()) and aggregated summary (report_aggregated())
Groups violations by severity level, violation code, and affected file paths for comprehensive overview
Color codes applied only when output is TTY (sys.stdout.isatty()), consistent with existing pattern
Early exit on --help/-h flags with detailed usage documentation
Uses os.path.relpath() with fallback to os.path.abspath() for paths outside working directory

gotchas_discovered.description: Relative paths starting with '..' are converted to absolute paths to ensure readability in reports
Function uses SEV_COLOR, BOLD, DIM, RESET constants that must be defined elsewhere in module
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify these constants exist in the module scope

gotchas_discovered.description: Code assumes ComplianceReport class exists with methods: count_by_severity(), count_by_code(), by_file(), total(), has_blockers()
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Must verify ComplianceReport class is properly imported/defined
